title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Luke 2: the enrollment under Caesar Augustus, the birth at Bethlehem, the shepherds, Simeon and Anna, and the boy Jesus in the temple.

questions.text: Whose decree sent everyone to be enrolled?
questions.explanation: In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

answers.text: Caesar Augustus
Quirinius, governor of Syria
Herod, the king of Judea
The council in Jerusalem

questions.text: Why did Joseph go up from Nazareth to Bethlehem, David's city?
questions.explanation: Joseph went up from Galilee, out of Nazareth, into Judea to David's city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David.

answers.text: Because the shepherds called him
Because an angel told him to go
Because he was of the house and family of David
Because he owned a field there

questions.text: Where did Mary lay her firstborn son after she had wrapped him in bands of cloth?
questions.explanation: She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

answers.text: In a bed in the inn
In a feeding trough
In the arms of Joseph
On a cloak in the field

questions.text: What were the shepherds doing in the same country when the angel stood by them?
questions.explanation: There were shepherds staying in the field, keeping watch by night over their flock, when an angel of the Lord stood by them.

answers.text: Driving their flock to Bethlehem
Sleeping in the city gate
Enrolling themselves for the decree
Keeping watch by night over their flock

questions.text: What did the shepherds say to one another when the angels went away from them into the sky?
questions.explanation: The shepherds said to one another that they should go to Bethlehem now and see this thing that had happened, which the Lord had made known to them.

answers.text: That they should stay with their flock until morning
That they should go up to the temple in Jerusalem
That they should go to Bethlehem and see what had happened
That they should say nothing about what they had heard

questions.text: What did the multitude of the heavenly army say as they praised God?
questions.explanation: They said, "Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men."

answers.text: "Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men"
"Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord"
"Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of the whole earth"
"Fear not, for a Savior is born to you today"

questions.text: What name was given to the child when eight days were fulfilled for his circumcision?
questions.explanation: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

answers.text: Emmanuel
John
Joseph
Jesus

questions.text: What had the Holy Spirit revealed to Simeon?
questions.explanation: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

answers.text: That he would serve in the temple all his life
That he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ
That a sword would pierce through his own soul
That he would speak to all the peoples of Israel

questions.text: Who was Anna, who came up at that very hour and gave thanks to the Lord?
questions.explanation: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who did not depart from the temple but worshiped with fastings and petitions night and day.

answers.text: A prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher
A widow of Bethlehem who kept the inn there
A servant of Simeon who worked in the temple
A woman of Nazareth who came up with Mary

questions.text: Where did Joseph and his mother find the boy Jesus after three days?
questions.explanation: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

answers.text: Among their relatives and acquaintances
On the road back to Nazareth
In the temple, sitting among the teachers
At the feast with the company
